notes.note: Titan warnings on all 6.2.15.5/6.2.15.6 tests (and 6.2.15.9-001a) are wrong: Titan does not implement the .from/.to selectors of map types (syntax error at from/to); syntax follows ExtendedFieldReference/ExtendedTypeFieldReference of annex A. Key/value enumeration order is unspecified, so the tests check contents order-independently.
Titan warnings on all 6.2.15.7 tests are wrong: Titan parses map types but does not implement map indexing/lengthof (and crashes on map values).
Ambiguity: the 'to'-only reading was used; all listed structured types are used as nested 'to' types, key type is charstring.
Hard to test directly: checks that after unmap the key is gone and that every remaining key has a present value.
Titan accepts this reject test because it does not implement map semantics; only the value field case is tested (a map key cannot syntactically be written as omit in most contexts).
Titan accepts this reject test because it does not implement map template checks.
Ambiguity: permission reading for templates used (omit/*/ifpresent allowed in map template value fields, semantics per B.1.2.1, B.1.2.4 and B.1.5); omit means the key is absent.

noexecution because the external function has no implementation. Titan warning is wrong: it cannot determine the type of a record variable passed to an 'any' parameter, but the requirement allows values of all types.
Of the listed contexts only the test case formal parameter is tested (unambiguous); the map/unmap ambiguity is therefore not exercised.
Titan warning is wrong: Titan requires strict typing between universal charstring and charstring, while 6.3.1 makes them compatible when all characters exist in charstring.
